## Summary
Build the admin dashboard page with real-time stats cards (faculty count, assessment items, pipeline runs) and a pipeline health indicator showing Inngest function status.

## User story
As an admin, I want to see a dashboard with key platform stats and pipeline health at a glance, so that I can monitor the system without digging through individual pages.

## Why this matters
The admin dashboard is the landing page after login. If stats are wrong (incorrect institution scoping), admins see other institutions' data (FERPA violation). If pipeline health is not visible, admins cannot detect stuck or failing Inngest pipelines until students report missing content.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Dashboard displays stat cards: total faculty, total assessment items, total lectures, active pipelines
- [ ] Stats are scoped to the admin's institution_id (RLS enforced)
- [ ] Pipeline health section shows last 10 Inngest function runs with status (success/failed/running)
- [ ] Stats refresh on page load (SSR) with client-side polling every 30 seconds
- [ ] Loading skeleton shown while stats are fetching
- [ ] Empty state shown gracefully when institution has no data yet (new setup)
- [ ] Page renders in < 30 lines, all logic in organisms/hooks

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Data Layer | createServerClient() in stats API route, createBrowserClient() in useDashboardStats hook |
| Data Layer (AP-16) | Row types from @journey/db/client for all query results |
| Atomic Design | StatCards + PipelineHealth are organisms in features/admin/components/, page < 30 lines |
| RLS | All stats queries scoped by institution_id via RLS — no app-level filtering as sole protection |

## Schema changes
```sql
-- No new tables. Stats are aggregated from existing tables:
-- profiles (faculty count), assessment_items (item count), lectures (lecture count)
-- Pipeline health may query an inngest_events or pipeline_runs table if it exists,
-- otherwise hits the Inngest REST API.

-- Optional: materialized view for dashboard stats (performance optimization)
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW public.institution_stats AS
SELECT
  p.institution_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.role = 'faculty' THEN p.id END) AS faculty_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ai.id) AS assessment_item_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS lecture_count
FROM public.profiles p
LEFT JOIN public.assessment_items ai ON ai.institution_id = p.institution_id
LEFT JOIN public.lectures l ON l.institution_id = p.institution_id
GROUP BY p.institution_id;
```

## API contract
```
GET /app/api/admin/stats
Headers: Authorization: Bearer [token]
Response 200: {
  data: {
    faculty_count: number,
    assessment_item_count: number,
    lecture_count: number,
    pipeline_runs: Array<{
      id: string,
      function_name: string,
      status: 'completed' | 'failed' | 'running' | 'cancelled',
      started_at: string,
      completed_at: string | null
    }>
  },
  error: null
}
Response 401: { data: null, error: { code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: string } }
```

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/admin/hooks/useDashboardStats.ts
'use client';
import { createBrowserClient } from '@journey/db/client';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export function useDashboardStats() {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const fetchStats = async () => {
      const res = await fetch('/api/admin/stats');
      const { data } = await res.json();
      setStats(data);
      setLoading(false);
    };
    fetchStats();
    const interval = setInterval(fetchStats, 30_000); // 30s polling
    return () => clearInterval(interval);
  }, []);

  return { stats, loading };
}

// app/(admin)/dashboard/page.tsx — < 30 lines
import { DashboardContainer } from '@/features/admin/components/DashboardContainer';
export default function DashboardPage() {
  return <DashboardContainer />;
}
```

// ✓ Use: DashboardContainer organism with useDashboardStats hook

// ✗ Data Layer: service_role in browser

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E02/E02-S04.api.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('GET /api/admin/stats returns institution-scoped stats', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/stats');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(200);
  const body = await res.json();
  expect(body.data).toHaveProperty('faculty_count');
  expect(body.data).toHaveProperty('assessment_item_count');
  expect(body.data).toHaveProperty('lecture_count');
  expect(body.data).toHaveProperty('pipeline_runs');
  expect(typeof body.data.faculty_count).toBe('number');
});

test('GET /api/admin/stats returns 401 when unauthenticated', async ({ request }) => {
  const res = await request.get('/api/admin/stats');
  expect(res.status()).toBe(401);
});

// tests/E02/E02-S04.ui.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Dashboard renders stat cards', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/dashboard');
  await expect(page.getByText(/faculty/i)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/assessment/i)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/lecture/i)).toBeVisible();
});

test('Dashboard renders pipeline health section', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/dashboard');
  await expect(page.getByText(/pipeline/i)).toBeVisible();
});

test('Dashboard shows loading state initially', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/dashboard');
  // Skeleton or loading indicator should be briefly visible
  const skeleton = page.locator('[data-testid="stats-skeleton"]');
  // May or may not catch it depending on speed — this is a best-effort check
});

test('Dashboard shows empty state for new institution', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto('/dashboard');
  // For a fresh institution, counts should be 0 with friendly messaging
  await expect(page.getByText(/0/)).toBeVisible();
});
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. `DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.institution_stats;`
2. No Neo4j changes to revert.
3. `git stash && git checkout develop`
